sources.snippet: DeepBERTa_zinc_base_100k_v4 A pretrained RoBERTa-style transformer model for learning molecular representations from DeepSMILES -encoded chemical structures. This model was trained on a corpus of 100,000 canonicalized molecules sampled from ZINC, using a BPE tokenizer with a vocabulary size of 767.
